item.title: Sieving the Pixels: Detecting AI-Generated Media in 2026
item.summary: The digital world is currently witnessing an influx of synthetically created media. Art, video, even music and short-form movies are being generated by AI models. And while early AI-generated images were often easy to spot due to various (and often amusing) anatomical errors, the latest models are producing results that can more easily pass muster. […]
